title: Add Pricing Table
content: Create pricing comparison table/cards. Structure: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 for three tiers. Card layout: plan name, price (large text-4xl font-bold), billing period, feature list with check/x icons, CTA button. Highlight recommended plan: scale-105, ring-2 ring-blue-500, "Popular" or "Recommended" badge. Feature comparison: icon prefix (Check for included, X or minus for excluded), text descriptions. Toggle for monthly/annual billing with discount badge. Add FAQ link below. Sticky header on scroll for comparison tables. Money-back guarantee badge. Custom/Enterprise tier with "Contact us" CTA. Animate price change on billing toggle.

variants.simple: Create pricing cards with plan names, prices, and feature lists.

variants.advanced: Create pricing comparison table/cards with billing toggle and feature comparison. Container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-16. Section header: text-center with title, subtitle explaining pricing. Billing toggle: flex justify-center mb-12, segmented control or switch for Monthly/Annual, discount badge ("Save 20%") next to Annual. Cards grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 items-start. Card structure: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border p-8, flex flex-col. Plan header: plan name (text-lg font-semibold), optional description. Price display: mt-4, currency symbol (text-2xl), amount (text-5xl font-bold), period (/month text-gray-500). Animate price change on toggle with number transition. Feature list: mt-8 space-y-4, each feature with Check icon (text-green-500) or X icon (text-gray-300) prefix, text-sm text-gray-600. CTA button: mt-8 w-full, primary for recommended (bg-blue-600), outline for others. Highlighted/recommended tier: relative scale-105, ring-2 ring-blue-500, "Most Popular" badge absolute -top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-blue-600 text-white text-sm px-3 py-1 rounded-full. Enterprise tier: "Custom" instead of price, "Contact Sales" CTA. Feature comparison table: alternative layout with features as rows, plans as columns, sticky header on scroll. Add-ons section: optional add-on features with +$X/mo. Trust elements: money-back guarantee badge, security badges, customer count. FAQ section below: common pricing questions. Responsive: stack cards on mobile with recommended first. Hover effects: subtle shadow increase, border color change. ACCESSIBILITY: proper table markup for comparison view, clear feature descriptions not just icons.
